name: Law Office of Mark F. Hughes III
what_they_do: Solo criminal/DWI defence practice: DWI and refusal (Alcotest) cases, suspended or uninsured driver charges, drug possession, theft/shoplifting, domestic-violence and juvenile matters in Middlesex and Monmouth County courts. Former municipal prosecutor, 20+ years.
customers: Individuals charged with DWI, criminal or disorderly-persons offences, and parents of juveniles, in central New Jersey.

size_signals.signal: Solo attorney site ('MARK F HUGHES III, ATTORNEY-AT-LAW') with two office addresses listed
Two locations: Little Silver (Monmouth County) and 4G Auer Court, East Brunswick (Middlesex County)
'PROTECTING OUR CLIENTS FOR OVER 20 YEARS' and prior service as a municipal prosecutor

listing.platform: Lawyers.com ('no client reviews yet') — Google Business Profile not verifiable

website_review.primary_cta: 'CALL NOW (732) 766-5703' block in the hero and repeated mid-page; no web CTA
website_review.trust_signals: 20+ years, former municipal prosecutor, photo of attorney, Alcotest-experience paragraph, two office addresses; no reviews, results or case examples
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Free Weebly template ('POWERED BY WEEBLY' footer), single page, 2010s design, all-caps body copy; no copyright year, no sitemap pages of substance
website_review.search_basics: Title is a run-on of name/titles/phone with no service or town; no meta description; single page, so no per-charge pages; no JSON-LD
top_issues: No contact form and no tel: link — the only conversion path is reading a number and dialling manually
Free-site-builder domain (hugheslaw.weebly.com) instead of the firm's own domain
No meta description, no service pages, no schema; title crams name+titles+phone
No reviews, case results or fee/consult details; two office addresses but no hours

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is the Weebly default (nothing meaningful blocked) but the site is a subdomain one-pager with no schema, no hours and no address/phone marked up; phone number appears only as text. Nothing an assistant can book, and little it can cite beyond the charge list.

operations_signals.signal: Phone-only intake ('Call (732) 766-5703' appears four times) — arrests and DWI questions arrive at night and weekends
Two county offices with no web intake or scheduling suggests the attorney personally fields every enquiry
No review footprint (Lawyers.com shows none for the East Brunswick listing), so no review-generation habit

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the Weebly one-pager with a small own-domain site: DWI/Alcotest, suspended-licence, domestic-violence and juvenile pages, click-to-call, and a consultation form
top_opportunities.evidence: Single Weebly page, no form, no tel: link, no meta description, title crammed with name and phone

top_opportunities.opportunity: 24/7 DWI hotline agent: answer after-hours arrest questions, capture court date and charge, and book the free consultation
top_opportunities.evidence: 'CALL NOW' repeated as the only path, two counties, no online booking or form

top_opportunities.opportunity: Review-request automation tied to case closure to build a Google profile for the East Brunswick office
top_opportunities.evidence: Lawyers.com shows no client reviews and the site shows none; only 'hundreds of clients' claim

scores.reasons: Gap 5: one-page free-builder site, no form, no click-to-call, no schema, no reviews. Pay 3: DWI defence is a high-fee, repeat-volume practice but this is a solo. Ease 5: a four-page site plus intake is a week's work. Evidence 4: page inspected at desktop and phone width; no listing rating could be seen.
